hypotheses that try to explain the impairment of the neuro-
transmission: (1) the ammonia hypothesis, (2) the synergistic 
neurotoxin hypothesis, and (3) the false neurotransmitter.

erated from the catabolism of proteins, amino acids, purines, 
and pyrimidines. Th e normal liver disposes of nitrogen from
amino acids by transamination and the formation of glutamic
acid. Th e nitrogen is then released as ammonia and enters the
